outstanding_todos: Draft ADR-009 (docs/architecture/decision-log/ADR-009-generation-runtime.md) on this branch with the five invariants, naming rationale, Done-means list, and benchmark-governance reference. (This branch's first deliverable.)
Decouple the three system prompts from ClaudeCLIGenerator into Sources/BCICloudBridge/Prompts/*.md; add a loader and tests asserting byte-identity across runtimes.
Add the GenerationRuntime protocol (Sources/BCICore/Protocols/GenerationRuntime.swift) with generate(...) + metadata; keep TextGenerating as a legacy alias.
Add the GenerationTransport protocol (Sources/BCICore/Protocols/GenerationTransport.swift); refactor ClaudeCLIGenerator to ClaudeCLIGenerationRuntime composed over a ClaudeCLITransport.

Implement OllamaGenerationRuntime (Sources/BCICloudBridge/) composed over an OllamaHTTPTransport; model name as a config field; verify against ollama list (deepseek-v4-flash:cloud, qwen2.5:3b, qwen2.5:1.5b, qwen2.5:0.5b, deepseek-r1:1.5b).

Add GeneratorFingerprint (struct: runtime, transport, provider, model, prompt_profile, interaction_style, prompt_hash, generation_parameters) as an optional field on DialecticalTurnEvent; update codec + Scripts/session-seed.py rollup keys.
Wire dialectic-session --runtime <name> --model <model>; env-var fallback (NEURALCOMPOSE_RUNTIME). Default = claude-cli for the existing app behavior.
Add --dry-run to dialectic-session for end-to-end wiring verification before live calls.
Run benchmark-001-grounding x 3 profiles x 3 runtimes x 3 seeds; compare against seed-002 Reflective reference; characterize tradeoffs.
Draft docs/architecture/benchmark-governance.md (immutability, versioning, deprecation, lifecycle, promotion rules). ADR-009 references it.

Update the privacy banner to disclose the active runtime and call count; per-transport opt-in surface for non-local runtimes (UI change in Sources/NeuralComposeApp/ — out of scope for this branch's core work).
Update CLAUDE.md / docs/seeds/ to record the new generation-runtime architecture; deprecate the 'single provider' framing in seed-003/known_risks once a second transport is live.
current_failures: Claude CLI rate-limited (verified 2026-07-21: 'weekly limit · resets Jul 24 at 6am (America/Chicago)'). Contemplative run on seed-003 deferred for this reason; the Ollama runtime in this branch is the architectural response, not a workaround.
known_risks: Cross-provider comparison is not apples-to-apples. Claude and Ollama backends have different model families, different context windows, different temperature semantics. The keep-bar is architectural, not behavioral — this is the explicit choice, but it means the comparison characterizes tradeoffs, not equivalences.

Ollama's :cloud variants route through the user's Ollama account, which is its own network-egress surface. The privacy banner must disclose this distinctly from the Claude CLI egress; the per-transport opt-in design is the mitigation.

Adding the generator fingerprint to DialecticalTurnEvent is a schema change. Old logs continue to decode (the field is optional and the codec is forward-compatible), but downstream consumers of the JSONL may need to be updated to surface the new fields.

The Ollama HTTP transport must handle local-server startup races, model-not-pulled errors, and per-model context-window differences. Initial implementation targets the local API; production deployment to the :cloud variant adds an additional network-egress surface that needs its own opt-in.
